description: Preregistered Pi SDK routing and workflow matrix for risk-based test policy.

amendments.reason: Initial preregistration before skill or extension prompt implementation.

Replace github-copilot/claude-haiku-4.5 after isolated SDK smoke returned zero-token error responses for every selected task. Error cells remain in ignored local results and are not reused. No task prompt or expected label changed.

Clarify that original preregistration chronology is author-attested because repository had no immutable commit history. Evaluation cases, prompts, expected outcomes, models, repetitions, and thresholds are unchanged.

Replace model-facing advisory tools with a skill-only runtime. Workflow evidence now comes from built-in tool chronology plus the final claimed evidence label. Cases, prompts, expected outcomes, models, repetitions, and thresholds are unchanged.

Harden built-in evidence inference with tool completion order, opaque-mutation rejection, anchored command recognition, and preregistered feature-specific red-output patterns. Task prompts, modes, labels, models, repetitions, and thresholds are unchanged.

Raise openai-codex/gpt-5.4-mini thinking from low to medium after a version-4 diagnostic loaded the skill but implemented production before its test. The failed diagnostic remains in local results and is not reused. Other model settings and all cases, prompts, expected outcomes, repetitions, and thresholds are unchanged.

Reject pre-red production, incomplete tool events, and detected opaque script mutations; add shipped-package provenance hashing after independent review. Cases, prompts, modes, labels, models, repetitions, and thresholds are unchanged.

Reject embedded command substitution in recognized test commands and exclude passing-test lines from feature-specific red matching after final review. Cases, prompts, modes, labels, models, repetitions, and thresholds are unchanged.

Add a package-layout anti-pattern case after a real repository task produced brittle path-blacklist tests. Require validation-only workflow and recognize npm pack dry runs as direct evidence. Existing cases, models, repetitions, and thresholds are unchanged.

Require dry-run package validation explicitly after the version-9 diagnostic used opaque tarball cleanup that correctly remained unsupported. Expected mode, artifacts, models, repetitions, and thresholds are unchanged.

Restrict npm pack validation evidence to dry runs and enforce case-specific allowed changed paths after independent review. Task prompt, expected mode and artifact, models, repetitions, and thresholds are unchanged.
Reject newline and background-operator shell composition so a valid dry run cannot mask a second package command. Cases, expected outcomes, models, repetitions, and thresholds are unchanged.

Add held-out Python TDD, Go metadata validation-only, and Rust preservation cases; recognize Python unittest and read-only Go module validation. Existing cases, models, repetitions, and thresholds are unchanged.

Align Python test-path detection and unittest discovery, classify standalone Go module mutations and read-only validation, and strengthen the Rust preservation contract after independent review. Task prompts, expected modes, models, repetitions, and thresholds are unchanged.

Remove an over-specific Rust source-pattern postcheck after it rejected a valid iterator refactor. Behavioral preservation checks, required source mutation, task prompt, modes, models, repetitions, and thresholds are unchanged.

system_prompt: You are a coding assistant. Follow loaded skills and use available repository tools. Complete the user's task, verify proportionally, preserve pre-existing work, and report only evidence you observed.
